lesson.title: Three days in the river
lesson.hook: he walks into the river Bein to bathe and is not seen for three days

title: three days in the river
hook: he went under. he didn't come up.
cast: today: a Malaysian Sikh nurse in Kuala Lumpur.

shots.scene: a small river at dawn, a figure seen from behind stepping in

No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Nothing gory: no blood, wounds or violence shown.
shots.caption: nanak steps into the water, goes under.
